acceptance_criteria: The source dataset remains the exact 33083-entry sealed PASS before and after training; V1 remains immutable FAIL with its 15-entry seal; V1R starts every seed from fresh initialization.

Exact 2-degree circular-roll tests pass for local axis and all exit headings. The formal no-update batch has finite complete loss/backward, positive association identities, unchanged weights and zero optimizer/checkpoint.

Seed0 epoch1 must show a learnable directional response: full-validation mean axis error below 60 degrees while event macro-F1 remains above 0.30. Otherwise stop and seal V1R rather than continuing other epochs/seeds.

Seeds 0/1/2 each complete at most 30 full-coverage epochs with patience 6, finite validation outputs and one best/last checkpoint; each epoch visits all 188126 train sequences and evaluates all 24462 validation sequences.

Checkpoint selection uses only minimum unaugmented validation total loss. C10/M-TARE reads, threshold calibration, graph replay and planner tuning remain zero. Host RSS <=16 GiB, GPU allocation <=28 GiB, per seed <=40000 seconds, total <=36 hours and output <=8 GiB.
baseline: Immutable V1 seed0 epoch1 is the causal architecture baseline: event macro-F1 0.530559 and finite geometry learning but axis error 79.7923 degrees because global pooling made the direction head invariant to its rotated target. V1R must show an epoch1 axis response before it is allowed to continue; V1 weights are never reused.

estimated_cost.compute: One RTX 5090 D, serial seeds 0/1/2, BF16 batch64. The corrected no-update batch uses about 2.68 GiB GPU. V1 measured 13.58 minutes for a full train+validation epoch; V1R may stop after epoch1 if directional learning is absent.

expected_evidence: V1 predecessor status/seal, V1R Data Card/spec/tool hashes, environment, exact source verification before/after and real-batch no-update smoke.
Per-seed full epoch logs including the seed0 epoch1 directional sanity evidence, checkpoints, full validation outputs, metrics, optimizer counts, time and memory.
Aggregate three-seed summary explicitly awaiting offline baseline/topology gates, raw logs, RUN_STATE and final SHA-256 seal.
After offline evaluation, paper learning curves and qualitative perception figures retained as PNG plus PDF/SVG with source data, generator, provenance and hashes.
method: Replace only the V1 directional bottleneck: fuse all five encoded frames independently at each retained azimuth, derive horizontal axis from a circular probability moment, derive each exit heading from its attention circular moment, and restrict train rolls to the exact four-column encoder lattice. Preserve all V1 data, Teacher, masks, normalized multitask losses, pair-aware batches, AdamW settings and validation-total-loss checkpoint selection.

optimization.initialization: fresh per seed; no V1 checkpoint reuse
optimization.selection: minimum validation total multitask loss independently per seed

question: Does explicitly circular-equivariant per-azimuth five-frame fusion repair the V1 unlearnable local-axis/exit-heading bottleneck while preserving event, metric, place and uncertainty learning across seeds 0/1/2 on the frozen 80/10 split?
stop_conditions: Seed0 epoch1 axis mean angular error at or above 60 degrees, event macro-F1 at or below 0.30, or any failure to reproduce circular equivariance.
Any data/Teacher/mask/loss/normalization/optimizer/epoch/patience/batch/selection change, frozen hash/environment/source drift, or reuse of V1 weights.
Any nonfinite value, sample omission/duplication, resource overrun, missing artifact, C10/M-TARE access, threshold calibration, topology replay or planner change.
